buttons.description: Actions at the right end of the bar. Prop objects render as SDS Buttons; elements are cloned with the header's appearance applied. An icon-only button gets an aria-label from its child, and in the narrow layout every button goes full width and closes the drawer when clicked.

menuProps.description: Props for the dropdown menus. Passing this replaces the default object rather than merging with it.

backgroundAppearance.description: "dark" puts the header on a dark surface and inverts its contents. It only changes anything in light mode.

logo.description: The logo displayed in the header. Can be an image, icon, svg or any ReactNode.

logoLinkComponent.description: Specifies the component to use for the logo link.

logoUrl.description: URL for the logo link. If provided, clicking the logo navigates to this URL.

isSticky.description: Whether the header sticks to the top on scroll. Ignored when sdsStyle is "drawer", which is always sticky, and best left alone alongside topComponentSlot.

topComponentSlot.description: Content rendered above the header, such as a Banner. The header measures it and offsets its own sticky top to match.

primaryNavItems.description: List of items for the primary navigation section.

primaryNavPosition.description: Position of the primaryNavItems list. If set to "left", the items appear to the left of the search bar. If set to "right", they are positioned next to the secondaryNavItems on the right.

sdsStyle.description: How dropdown nav items open, and which parts of their data are used. See the comparison above.

scrollElevation.description: Controls whether a shadow is shown under the Nav when scrolling.

searchProps.description: Props passed to the search input component.
searchProps.type: Partial<OutlinedTextFieldProps & AccessibleInputSearchProps & InputSearchExtraProps> | Partial<StandardTextFieldProps & AccessibleInputSearchProps & InputSearchExtraProps> | Partial<FilledTextFieldProps & AccessibleInputSearchProps & InputSearchExtraProps>

secondaryNavItems.description: List of items for the secondary navigation section.

showSearch.description: Whether to display the search input in the header.

tag.description: A small label displayed next to the title.

tagColor.description: The color of the tag label.

title.description: The main title displayed in the header.

activePrimaryNavKey.description: The key of the active primary item. Optional, since the header tracks this itself; when given, it overrides the internal value.

setActivePrimaryNavKey.description: Called when a primary item becomes active. The header updates its internal key as well, so this is a notification rather than the only way the value changes.

drawerOpen.description: Controls the narrow layout's drawer. Leave both this and setDrawerOpen out to let the hamburger manage it.

setDrawerOpen.description: Replaces the drawer's internal state update, so it has to be paired with drawerOpen or the drawer stops opening.

onDrawerStyleNavItemHover.description: (item: NavigationHeaderPrimaryNavItem<T> | NavigationHeaderSecondaryNavItem) => void. Called with the hovered primary or secondary item while sdsStyle is "drawer". Useful for prefetching what the panel will show.

logoLinkProps.description: Props to pass to the logo link component.

details.description: A caption under the label, drawn only when sdsStyle is "drawer". In dropdown style it lands on the element as an attribute and shows nothing.

icon.description: An icon for the row, drawn only when sdsStyle is "drawer". A named icon renders at 24px when the row has details and 16px when it does not, so the name has to offer that size.

section.description: Groups rows under a heading. Rows are grouped by this value in the order the sections first appear.

onClick.description: Runs on click, then the menu closes.

href.description: Turns the row into a link to this URL.

component.description: What the link renders as, for routing through something other than an anchor.

target.description: Where the link opens, for example "_blank".

rel.description: The link's relationship to the target, for example "noreferrer".

actions.description: Links rendered under the section, for example a "Browse all". Each takes label plus href, onClick, component, target, and rel.

colSpan.description: How many columns of the panel this section occupies.
